title: Report Re Admiral Tseng I. Ting

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

File No.
MUNICIPAL POLICE
& S.I. REGISTRY
S. D. D. 3053
S. 1. Station,
c.e 5 / 1 / 32
Date January 5, 1932

Subject (in full) Admiral Tseng I Ting.

Made by Supt. Tan Shao-liang. Forwarded by Tho Robertson, Supt.

Admiral Tseng I Ting is identical with Commodore Tseng
whose promotion to Rear Admiral was announced a few days ago.
Admiral Tseng is a native of Fokien and has served in the
navy for the past 30 years. He was in charge of the Destroyer
Squadron until recently when he was promoted to be Commander of the
2nd Squadron, plying in the Yangtsze River.

Tan Shaoliang
Superintendent.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

Jacle

日期：1932年1月5日

事由（全称）：曾以鼎海军上将。

由谭绍良警司编制。经罗伯逊警司转呈。

曾以鼎海军上将与数日前宣布晋升为海军少将的曾司令官系同一人。曾上将系福建人，过去三十年间一直在海军服役。直至最近晋升为长江流域航行的第二舰队司令之前，他一直担任驱逐舰支队指挥官。

谭绍良
警司

特别分部主管警官。

Jacle
Mll

page_data.en:
SF
5:1:32
Please let me know particulars
of Admiral Tseng I-Ting, who
was formerly in charge of the
Destroyer Squadron, and who has
a day or two ago assumed
command of the 2nd Naval
Squadron, Hankow. Is he
identical with Commodore Tseng
whose promotion to Rear Admiral
was announced a few days ago?
Please endeavour to obtain this
information as early as possible.
Enquiry on behalf of Royal Naval
Office.
J.H.
page_data.zh:
SF
1932年1月5日
请提供曾以鼎海军上将的详细情况，他此前负责驱逐舰支队，并于一两天前接任驻汉口的海军第二舰队司令。他是否与数日前宣布晋升为海军少将的曾司令官系同一人？
请尽力尽早获取此信息。
应英国皇家海军办事处之询。
J.H.
